disclaimer.short: For entertainment and self-reflection only. Tarot cannot predict the future.
disclaimer.long: $t(appName) is made for entertainment and personal reflection. The cards do not predict the future and are not a substitute for professional advice about health, money, legal or personal matters. You are always the one who decides what is right for your life.
